rag_summary:
Autex Horizon - Triangle is a 24mm thick floating
acoustic ceiling panel crafted in a 1159mm x 1159mm right-angle triangle
from 100% polyester fibre. Designed to be suspended as a cloud-like feature or
direct-fixed to walls without glue, it absorbs 0.8 to 1.4 Sabins per unit to
control echo and reverberation in open-plan spaces. Featuring a Group 1 fire
rating under AS ISO 9705 and containing at least 80% recycled PET, it provides a
lightweight, carbon-neutral acoustic solution for commercial, educational, and
hospitality interiors.

description:

distinctive 3D angled peak profile folded from 12mm Cube polyester felt.

low-frequency sound absorption while transforming flat walls into sculptural
architectural features. It installs quickly using a dedicated mechanical
clipping system that eliminates the need for adhesives and ensures clean,
precise joins.

absorption ratings from NRC 0.45 to 0.80 and Group 1 fire compliance.

severe reverberation across walls and ceilings.

description:

ceiling baffle system featuring an organic, cloud-like seedpod form. Constructed
